title: H176: PEAD via Press Release FinBERT Embeddings
rationale: arXiv:2509.24254 (Wu et al., Sept 2025) applies FinBERT embeddings to 138k press releases (2005-2023) and finds press release sentiment is 'as informative as earnings surprise' for predicting short-window announcement returns. Critically, they use full-open pricing at market open — the same entry mechanics as H174. H174 currently scores 8-K SEC filings; press releases are issued slightly earlier (before market open on earnings day), potentially giving a 15-30 minute execution edge. H176 would test: same scoring pipeline as H174 but applied to press releases fetched via GlobeNewswire/BusinessWire RSS, compared against H174's 8-K score. If press releases score at least as well as 8-Ks, they can replace or augment H174. Relevance: 8/10. Direct upgrade path for the confirmed H174 strategy.
